description: This file defines a readonly struct 'MdPdfMsg' used for representing PDF rendering messages within the MigraDoc project, including properties for message ID and text, and generating event identifiers.

classes.name: MdPdfMsg
classes.description: A struct representing a message related to PDF rendering in MigraDoc, encapsulating a message ID, message text, and associated event information.

methods.name: EventId
methods.description: Property that creates an EventId using the message ID and name, for logging or event attribution.

methods.name: EventName
methods.description: Property that returns a string representation of the message ID, used as the event name.
